notes: Upstream-clone debugging task on matplotlib/matplotlib at parent commit 74c7f9a598c4e32b3f551f75ed965f446d786ab1 (real upstream issue #28383, fixed upstream by commit 00cbd9cd3255dcbcb75e3090b144a8e18a900247). Transform.contains_branch_seperately documents a per-axis containment answer (pair of booleans), but CompositeGenericTransform has no override and falls back to the base Transform implementation, which returns [contains_branch(other)] * 2 — a two-element list whose entries are BOTH the whole-composite answer, so a composite whose right-hand side is a blended (per-axis) transform reports (False, False) even when the y branch genuinely contains the other transform; upstream's axes limit-tracking code (e.g. axvspan in non-rectilinear cases and fill_between with a custom transform) then skips limit updates. The upstream fix (2 hunks in lib/matplotlib/transforms.py): add a contains_branch_seperately override to CompositeGenericTransform (identity shortcut (True, True) + delegation to self._b) and change the base class return from a list to a tuple. The image clones the repo with only the parent commit in the object store (fix commit unreachable, rev-list --all --count == 1), builds and installs it editable with meson-python (freetype/harfbuzz/qhull vendored as meson subprojects, fetched at build time), and extracts the upstream regression test (fix-commit lib/matplotlib/tests/test_transforms.py, containing the added assertions in TestBasicTransform::test_contains_branch) into /opt/golden at build time, never into this tree. Dependency pins identical to sibling matplotlib task ballast-longshore: pyparsing 3.1.4 (must stay < 3.2.0: matplotlib's pytest config turns warnings into errors and pyparsing 3.2.0's resetCache deprecation otherwise aborts collection), pytest 8.4.2, numpy 2.5.3, pybind11 3.1.0, meson-python 0.16.0, meson 1.12.0, ninja 1.13.2, contourpy 1.3.3, kiwisolver 1.5.1, cycler 0.12.1, fonttools 4.65.0, packaging 26.3, certifi 2026.7.22, pillow 12.3.0, python-dateutil 2.9.0.post0, setuptools-scm 10.2.3, setuptools 84.0.0. Verifier: tree provenance (HEAD==parent, fix commit absent, exactly one commit, byte-level equality of every tracked file except lib/matplotlib/transforms.py against the parent blobs, no untracked non-ignored files), imports matplotlib from /app/src, copies the golden test file over the tree and requires TestBasicTransform::test_contains_branch to pass (fails on the parent tree: assert y is sy is True with sy False), runs a subset of the project's own existing TestBasicTransform node ids (test_transform_depth, test_left_to_right_iteration, test_transform_shortcuts, test_affine_simplification, and the identity/equality checks in test_contains_branch's unchanged portion via TestBasicTransform::test_transform_depth etc.) to prove nothing else broke, runs the issue reproduction, and runs three authored hidden cases with inputs the upstream test never uses: an x-axis mirror of the blended containment (x contained, y not), deep composite nesting two levels deep with identity (self-containment -> (True, True)) and all-contained / none-contained matrix, and the return-type contract for plain affine/non-affine/identity transforms (must be a 2-tuple of real bools, never a list). The hidden cases fail against the parent tree and pass only with the upstream two-part fix. Typical trial runtime: pytest ~15-30s at 1 CPU, no image comparisons involved. Verified env: python 3.12.13, bench-base:python-3.12.
